Subject: Post weekly sync — action roll-forward & clarifications

Thanks team — quick note to capture the owners and open questions from today’s cross-functional sync with Acme. I pulled together an initial action tracker (attached) and called out a couple of exec asks that will need prioritization for the QBR pack. Please review and update by EOD Monday so I can consolidate for the exec slide deck.

Top-line asks and owners:
- Data residency options for Acme (Evelyn) — need SOC2 evidence + KMS mapping for EU pilot; deliverable: evidence packet. Due: 2026-12-20.
- Token-cost estimate for 50k monthly active users on 8k context (Marcus) — provide configuration options (dedicated vs hosted) and 3 cost scenarios. Due: 2026-12-17.
- Roadmap clarification: model rollout timing around quantized 13B (Karthik) — confirm compatibility with their latency SLO and any manual rollback plan. Due: 2026-12-18.
- Demo checklist & success criteria (Lauren) — finalize happy-path scenarios and pick two prompts for perf runs. Due: 2026-12-16.

Open questions from Acme (Jordan in thread):
1) Which regions will support private deployment in H1 2027?
2) Can we commit to a 99.9% inference availability SLA for Dedicated pools?

Attachments: QBR_exec_asks_v1.xlsx (action matrix), post_sync_action_tracker.csv (owners + due dates).

Thanks — I’ll do one follow-up to consolidate changes and then share the master deck with Sales.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. PM, Go-to-Market | Redwood Inference

- Lauren: demo scripts (US + EU) + sample data collection — due 2026-12-16.
